test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: At what annual rate of compound interest, compounded semi-annually, will ₹57,600 become ₹72,900 in one year?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal Amount (P) = ₹57,600

Amount (A) = ₹72,900

Time (T) = 1 year

Compounding frequency = Semi-annually

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest Formula: A = P (1 + (r)/(n))ⁿt

Where:

 
• A = Amount
 
• P = Principal
 
• r = Annual interest rate (in decimal)
 
• n = Number of times interest is compounded per year
 
• t = Time the money is i
